scan.summary: This is the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission's Producer License for Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to operate a Tier II indoor cannabis cultivation facility at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, with a 10,000 square foot mature plant canopy limit. The license was issued for the current term on March 3, 2026 and expires March 2, 2027. As a permit, it contains no gaps—compliance means meeting its conditions and renewing before expiration.
scan.freshness_note: This license is current and within its term. Renewal must be initiated no later than February 10, 2027 (20 days before expiration).

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all identity, date, and condition information—these are directly stated on the license. High confidence on expiration and renewal deadlines. The license itself is the agency's document and contains no regulatory gaps; all conditions are clearly stated. Confidence is complete on what this document says and proves. Not certain whether supporting documentation (CTS enrollment, worker permits, video surveillance specifications, ownership records) exists elsewhere in the company's files. OAR 845-025-1450 reference for video surveillance is cited correctly but the actual technical requirements are in that regulation, not in this license.
